answer: At the narrow mouth of the canyon the crowd's glacier melts a fixed measure each epoch, and that melt is the pot every claim draws from. A holder whose share a claim would push below the nadir they can live with writes one refusal against that claim, and a claim carrying refusals worth a tenth of the melt settles at zero. No farm can buy refusals or manufacture the crowd that owns them: every extra head divides the melt thinner, so more holders fall under their nadir, and the marginal head is the one refused, ending the epoch with a whole epoch's work paid to no one.
